purpose: End-to-end causal validation: test whether frozen detector-triggered VIS attacks can selectively cause gripper-mediated task failures on held-out objects, above matched random-time controls.

phase_a_canary.purpose: Engineering smoke test only. NOT included in formal results.
phase_a_canary.rationale: Cover four distinct detector behavior profiles: HIGH_FRAME_FPR, LOW_COVERAGE, TIMING_DEVIATION, SCORE_SATURATION
checks: Target OPEN token logit increases under perturbation
Gripper qpos/width responds to attacked action
Arm action does not diverge catastrophically

phase_b_formal.purpose: Formal held-out VIS validation. All 9 confirmatory folds.
phase_b_formal.total_rollouts_per_condition: 9 folds x 2 states x 3 detector_seeds x 3 pert_seeds = 162 (state chosen once per fold, reused across conditions)
phase_b_formal.state_selection_rules: See LOTO_VIS_STATE_SELECTION_V1.json. States selected BEFORE any VIS run. Selection criteria: state_id sorted ascending, pick first two states with clean_success=true, teacher_positive=true, trace_complete=true, target_valid=true.

conditions.name: CLEAN
conditions.description: Unmodified OpenVLA rollout. Baseline for task success rate and gripper behavior.

conditions.name: VIS + Student Trigger
conditions.description: Prefix Log-Ratio VIS attack targeting gripper OPEN. Attack triggered at detector EMIT step. If no EMIT, no attack (ITT).

conditions.name: VIS + Random-Time Control
conditions.description: Same VIS payload. Trigger time sampled uniformly from [guard, episode_length - K]. Same window length as student trigger.

conditions.name: Matched RAND + Student Trigger
conditions.description: Matched-random gripper perturbation (not targeted OPEN). Same trigger timing as student trigger. Controls for: is VIS specifically needed, or any gripper perturbation at that time works?

conditions.name: Adapted TMA + Student Trigger
conditions.description: Token-manipulation attack adapted for gripper. Same trigger timing. Controls for: is the Prefix Log-Ratio method specifically needed?

conditions.name: VIS + Early-Shift Control
conditions.description: Same VIS payload. Trigger K steps BEFORE student EMIT. Controls for: is the student-chosen window specifically more effective than a nearby window?

itt_definition.description: Intent-to-Treat: ALL pre-registered episodes are included in the denominator, regardless of whether the detector emitted.
itt_definition.detector_no_emit_handling: If detector does not EMIT on an episode, the episode is recorded as NO_INTERVENTION for that condition. It is NOT excluded from the denominator.
itt_definition.secondary_analysis: Conditional Task-ASR = (task failures) / (episodes where detector emitted AND attack executed)
itt_definition.note: ITT will be lower than conditional for folds with low detector coverage (Fold 05, 07). This reflects real end-to-end system performance.

ep1.name: Task-ASR (ITT)
ep1.definition: Fraction of all pre-registered episodes where task_success=false (by official LIBERO check_success AND manual CQFR review). ITT denominator includes all episodes regardless of detector emission.
ep1.comparison: VIS+StudentTrigger vs VIS+RandomTime: difference in ITT Task-ASR. One-sided: student > random?

ep2.name: TASR (gripper OPEN rate)
ep2.definition: Fraction of attacked steps where gripper_command > 0 (OPEN). Measures whether VIS successfully controls the gripper token.

ep3.name: NAD_gripper vs NAD_arm
ep3.definition: Normalized Action Deviation for gripper dimension vs mean of 6 arm dimensions. Measures selectivity of the attack's effect on actions.
ep3.comparison: VIS conditions: NAD_gripper should be substantially larger than NAD_arm

secondary_endpoints.cqfr_components: drop rate, premature-release rate, bad-placement rate (manual review)
secondary_endpoints.end_to_end_latency: detector EMIT step -> first attacked action step -> first gripper OPEN action step -> first physical gripper response
secondary_endpoints.sustained_open_duration: Number of consecutive steps with gripper OPEN after attack
secondary_endpoints.target_logit_margin: OPEN logit - CLOSE logit after perturbation

analysis_requirements.no_post_hoc_fold_exclusion: All 9 folds included in primary analysis. No fold dropped based on VIS results.
analysis_requirements.no_post_hoc_state_exclusion: Pre-selected states retained regardless of outcome.
analysis_requirements.subgroup_analysis: Pre-registered: report results by detector failure mode (CLEAN, LOW_COVERAGE, TIMING_DEVIATION, HIGH_FRAME_FPR, SCORE_SATURATION).
analysis_requirements.random_time_comparison: Student Trigger ASR > Random-Time ASR is necessary (not sufficient) for claiming detector identifies causally-relevant windows.
analysis_requirements.manual_cqfr_required: LIBERO check_success() is NOT sufficient. Manual video review for contact-quality failure classification is required for all attack episodes.

prohibited_actions: Selecting folds with high VIS success and calling it confirmatory
Excluding no-emission episodes from ITT denominator
Changing state selection after seeing VIS results
Tuning detector threshold based on VIS success
Re-training detector after seeing VIS results
Using official SR without manual CQFR for attack episodes
